answer: Sybil flood is the problem: one operator can spin cheap clones to capture seats. Mechanism: stake a 48-hour bonding bridge before any vote weight accrues; new identities must sit on a graded terrace of three peer reviews that each cost 0.8 spendable, and only after crossing a reputation canyon of 12 unique attestors from distinct epochs do they unlock panel seats. Cost is paid upfront and burned on fail. Verification: ledger counts distinct attestor epochs and rejects same-wallet clusters. Failure: if any review scores 0 or attestors collapse below 12, bond locks 72h and seat rights reset.
